## Description

Context: what we decided and why. The pilot cannot wait for the full console (MDV-P5-044, weeks 26 to 29). The owner decided a simple approval queue is built now in the platform console, approved by a configured Medvya operations user; until the console runs on Azure, a documented API call does the same and stays.
What to build. An organisation-approval capability replaces OperationsPolicies.LicenceReview and the Operations:LicenceReviewers id list. Operations endpoints (reason of 5 to 500 characters, audited, applicant emailed a plain reason for changes, rejection or suspension) list Submitted requests and apply approve, ask for changes, reject and suspend. A simple queue page in web/platform-admin calls them. The review reads only the control-plane request and documents through a narrow reviewed read path (ADR-014), never clinic patient data. Document the API call in docs/runbooks.
Touched: Medvya.Tenancy.Api/DoctorEndpoints.cs (remove licence verify and reject routes and OperationsPolicies), Medvya.Tenancy.Infrastructure/LicenceReview.cs and ILicenceReview (remove), Host.Platform and Medvya.Platform (queue read path and page), web/platform-admin, a configured operations user list, docs/runbooks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a user without the organisation-approval capability, when they call the endpoints or open the queue, then they get 403.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a Submitted request, when a configured operations user approves, asks for changes, rejects or suspends with a reason, then the state changes, the audit names the operator, and the applicant is emailed the reason.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an action without a reason, when it is sent, then it is rejected.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given any queue or approval endpoint, when it returns data, then it holds no patient field and logs none (architecture test).
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the console is not deployed, when an operator follows the runbook, then the documented API call approves a request.

## Test notes

- Unit: transition rules and reason validation.
- Integration on real PostgreSQL: each transition, audit entry, email, role refusal; the console login cannot read clinic schemas.
- Playwright: platform console queue approve and ask-for-changes path; J1 step 1 ends at Approved.
- Security: ponytail-review, mutation check on the capability, reason-on-every-action test.
- Browser: English, queue page axe clean.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
